Give it all you've got!
They believe in me!
I wish that mama could be with us. I always like it best when I can be with both of you.
Anya wants to go to school and help papa! Anya will do her best!
I have to hide my power too. If he finds out I can read minds, I'll have to run away.
Papa and Mama are flirting.
My papa and mama are both so much fun, and I love them very much.
I believe in him. Because I love him. And so... I am going to summon all my courage to tell him I failed!
I've had so much excitement ever since I left the orphanage.
I like peanuts.
If I train and get strong, I won't be scared! I can study hard and not die! I want to be like you, Mama!
Meat you in the courtyard.
What's a grammar?
Papa's a spychiatrist.
Yeah, I'm kind of busy doing nothing. Sorry.
It's a snotaconda!
Knowledge is a swole chihuahua.
I hate having to wait. And I hate the smell of you. Want me to scratch you back?
I don't care what the old lady says! You are not Kikyo, ya got that!!? I am so outta here!!
That's just ludicrous! You may very well despise me but the feeling's not mutual. Kikyo...I never stop thinking of you! Not even for an instant!!
I could never hate you or think less of you. It's your spirit I care about, not your appearance.
There was no place for me, so I had to make one for myself, and then I realized, I had a place, but I was the only one in it. I didn't know any other way to live.
You got two legs and a heartbeat. What's stopping you?

I'm a half-demon, more egotistical and greedy than any other living creature — that's what human beings are, right? But with human blood flowing through my veins, I never give up! Don't you understand? When you have someone to protect, your power increases multifold!
I...I don't know. But given the choice, I choose to LIVE!!
Whatever. It's not even me you dislike, it's this Kikyo person. I'm not Kikyo, okay? I'm Kagome. Can't we just call a truce?
Personally, I like you just the way you are, Inuyasha.
Nothing will ever satisfy you, because the Shikon Jewel didn't grant your real wish!
I want you to be happy. I want you to laugh a lot. I don't know what exactly I'll be able to do for you, but I'll always be by your side.
Not as pretty as his, huh? What would you know about it? You live in a time where they don't even have shampoo.
Indeed. I've quite missed you as well, little brother.
When it comes to humans, I of course, bear no such weakness.
The path I walk is of supreme conquest. And it is power that will reveal the way for me.
Protect? The answer is no. I, Sesshomaru, have no need of such.
I see you no longer have the strength to put up a barrier. It looks like that arrogance of yours will turn out to be your downfall. And so I shall deliver the finishing blow.
Calm down. If I had that information I would have slain him long ago myself.
Tenseiga is the sword of life. And when Sesshomaru's life is in danger, despite his dark soul, the Tenseiga chooses to save him. And that is what makes him invincible.
Despite his appearance he does have a kind side to him.
Life itself is a frightening image for every human being. Being strong in life isn't easy.
Don't underestimate me!! I am a demon-slayer!! I won't fall for Naraku's tricks!!
What choice do I have but to trust my younger brother!?
You make it sound as if kindness is a bad thing.
Naraku, turn Kohaku back to his former self immediately!
I won't feel it much longer. And so I give this to you. The Shikon no Tama which you must burn with my body. It must not fall into the hands of those who would abuse it.
When Inuyasha and I parted, we despised one another. The love you speak of is but a shallow emotion. Nothing can fuel the desire for enacting vengeance. Only bitterness can.
We are unable to turn back the hands of time. So please allow me to embrace you a little longer.
Inuyasha, never forget the feel of my lips against yours. For it was real. Never forget.
You must never be with Inuyasha again, nor I. For I am one of the dead and as such I, too, don't belong here.
The future is not a straight line. There are many different pathways. We must try to decide the future for ourselves.
Once the thread of fate is tangled, it cannot be undone.
That must be Midoriko's version of "Sit!"
This woman is off limits! I'll kill anyone who tries to take a bite!
She risked her life to save her friend. She's loyal. I'm gonna make you my woman.
In this modern age, sword fighting isn't the thing to do, you know. Sorry, but there's something I want to watch on TV at four.
Having no money is like having a sinus infection. You just have to ignore it and not pick at it, and it'll go away.
Don't run away! You yourself have to change first, or nothing will change for you!
A samurai doesn't need a reason to do what's right. If you want to protect her, you must draw your sword.
As long as I'm alive, I'll live by my own rules. I'll live as I see fit and protect that which I hold dear.
The best way to live a full life is to be a child, no matter what your age.
I'm sorry, but I'm not the kind of guy who'd take a man's life just to settle a score. I'll risk mine instead.
Men don't need to speak the same language. They can communicate on a spiritual level.
A man should be responsible, even when joking. A man should keep his promises.

Weep and ask for help. Lean on me with your runny nose. Cry when you feel like crying. Laugh when you feel like laughing. When you're tearing up with an ugly face, I'll give you a good cry with an uglier face. When you're laughing so hard your stomach hurts, I'll laugh in a louder voice. That's how it should be. It's far better to get dirty while living true to yourself, than to throw away yourself and die a clean death.

Tears are handy for washing away troubling and sad feelings. But when you grow up, you'll learn that there are things so sad, they can never be washed away by tears. So people who are truly strong laugh when they want to cry.

The night is darkest just before dawn. But keep your eyes open; if you avert your eyes from the dark, you'll be blind to the rays of a new day. So keep your eyes open, no matter how dark the night ahead may be.
The world looks different through a smiling face and a crying face, you know? If you have the power to smile through difficult times, then you have nothing to fear. Even hell becomes heaven for you.
Manga endings might always be the same. However when it comes to real life, neither you nor I are readers. We are the writers. We can change the ending.
Stress makes you bald, but it's stressful to avoid stress, so you end up stressed out anyway. In the end, there's nothing you can do.
I wonder what lies in this man's soul. I can't really tell at all, but…though it's dim, I can see a light shining through. I think I'll stay with him and look at that light a bit longer.
It's the same as always. He doesn't pursue those who leave, and ignores those who come.
In the end, the idiots are just used. But I like those idiots better. I hate you though.
No matter what mistakes he may make, I have to protect him. If you don't like it, you can get out. I'll never leave him.
It's thanks to him that we Shinsengumi can walk the streets, heads held high. We chose to follow him.
The path of evil slithers like a serpent.
Sorry, Kondo-san. I lost to him, as well.
It's better to work towards your dreams than let them wither away.
He's an interesting man. I'd like to cross swords with him myself.
If you see anyone in trouble, be it good guy or bad guy, you should help them out. This is something all humans should do.
Monkeys we may be, but monkeys with nerves of steel and hearts of samurai!
Your right hand can't carry the entire burden. From now on, I'm your left arm.
Anyone can show his fangs if it is to protect something. But you, without anything to protect, are nothing but a wild beast, Takasugi.
You may still be young, kiddo, but remember to think about the consequences before you do anything. Life's pretty long, you know.
In the end, wherever I went, I was a madao.
Even though it looked ugly, on the inside it wasn't. It just wanted to play, I guess. Every creature of the sea is good.
Does a child need a reason to protect something his parents loved?
Please go, I beg you. I wish to stay as your equal. When I'm with you, my resolve weakens.
People are born weak, but we have the freedom to defy our weaknesses and struggle to change ourselves.

I don't mind you spreading whatever rumors you want about me. If I'm being an eyesore, then I'll be on my way somewhere else. However, if you point your swords at my students, then I wouldn't mind overthrowing something like a government.
If that's the case, I'll dig as far as needed.
My name is Shadow: he who lurks in the shadows to hunt the shadows.
If I don't want to be vaporized in a nuclear explosion, I simply have to become nuclear myself… I am Atomic.
So this business is pretty profitable, I presume?

My organization was never walking the path of righteousness, but we don't walk the path of evil either. We only walk down our own path. If you can do that, then go ahead. Bring me the guilt for all the crimes in all the world. I will gladly accept all of it. But it won't change anything. Even with that, I... We will do what we must do.
Well done, my beautiful sword wielder.
When a holy sword is removed from its sheath, its sparkling blade is set free, and it sets off on a quest for the Garden of Chaos.
I am the All-Range... Atomic.
Delta, that's why you shouldn't lie.
There is no road to almightiness for those using borrowed strength. None!
True strength lies not in one's power, but in one's way of being.

I make a very clear distinction between what's important to me and what's not. As people go through life, they collect more things that have value to them. They make friends, find significant others, get jobs. But me? I trimmed the fat. And when I was done... all I had left was what I absolutely couldn't do without. And that's why I don't particularly care what happens to anything else.
Epsilon is a very proud woman. I can tell by the amount of slime she's piled onto herself.
I don't want to be the hero. I don't want to be the last boss. I want to be the one in the story who operates from the shadows, showing everyone their greatness: The Eminence in Shadow!
We lurk in the shadows to hunt the shadows. That is the only reason for our existence.
An assassin who neglects to sharpen his blade is no assassin at all.
The difference between the novice and the master is that the master has failed more times than the novice has tried.
I study too, you know. How could I teach anyone if I didn't grow and learn day by day?
Take advantage of what you have, while you have it.
Failure and frustration can be wellsprings for growth. Surely this will make them all stronger.
One of the best ways to deepen your own understanding is to teach someone else.
Conflict can be the best opportunity to strengthen a friendship.
Everyone wants attention, approval. The legendary assassin understood the joy of being seen.
Talent is usually an invisible trait — more often than not, it's the result of work.
From where I'm standing, everyone has their own talent.
We were looked down on, but we never stopped looking up.
Everything we experience is a tool for clearing one's path.
If something is possible, carry on as planned. Even if it isn't possible, do it anyway.
Feelings are difficult to kill.
Hatred only gets you so far.
The thing about defeat is that it gives you perspective. So I'm asking you: give the teacher a lesson.
You don't have to win now, just someday. Slow and steady wins the race.
It's about being patient, picking your moment.
I am simply one hell of a butler.
I'm afraid once something is truly lost, one can never get it back again.
It's time to put an end to this worthless game.
Bewitched by the eyes of the dead.
Think carefully. Should you reject the faith, even as once the gates of paradise will forever be out of your reach.
I'm not in the habit of abandoning a game half-way through.
If you disappear, I will be most distressed and worried. Because if my master is not here, I wouldn't be able to be your butler.
Only two kinds of people exist in this world; those who steal and those who are stolen from…
I am Ciel Phantomhive. That is my one and only name.
How sad should it be... that laughter should vanish from this place.
There might be an interesting development lurking behind the ending credits.
To greet my master in a tidy manner every day. That is a maid's duty. The housemaid shall purge the filth from this manor!
I wouldn't be here if it wasn't for you! I couldn't do anything but destroy, but you taught me how to grow! You made me from #12 into Finnian!
If someone means any harm against the young master in this mansion, no matter who they are, those servants will have no mercy on them.
I'm fine with not being cute... if it means I can protect you!!
There's something unshakable between him and the earl after all the time they have spent together.
This is an order. Save me!
I am bound to my master by a sacrifice, a wish and a contract. Until the day I take his soul.
I'll atone with my death.
If you should decide to rest eternally, I ask that you please do so outside.
Wouldn't you agree with me, hmm? My little Grim Reapers?
Humans recall their pasts in their final moments. That is their Cinematic Record.
Has Your Lordship finally decided to step into the coffin that I've made specially for you?
A person has but one soul.
At this moment, my body and soul, to the last hair, belong to my master.
Even though I dislike being kicked by others, I do enjoy the feeling of kicking others.
No. I won't abandon hate. If I do, nothing would be left of me.
I prefer to have my nightmares with open eyes.
Death is like being born, but backwards. It only hurts for a little while, then a new life begins. A life with no sorrow, no pain, a glorious new beginning. A beginning that will last an eternity.

Moping around with sadness and sorrow… what will come of it? Even dead people can do that. However, I'll live and stand on my own two legs. If we are going to die one day, wouldn't it be better to have no regrets?
Love is a magnificent thing but, incidentally, it can also give birth to dreadful tragedy.

There is nothing shameful about being different from others. This is your character! Ann's red hair is really beautiful, just like the color of red spider lilies in their full bloom. Red really suits you. You should have more confidence in yourself.
In this universe of ours, the birth of a new life on some corner of our planet is nothing but a tiny, insignificant flash. Death is a normal thing.
The only thing people are equal in is death.
The big secret to breaking the rules is to make it look as though you're following them.
Hatred is born when people gather together.
How weak the mind is when it wants to forget.
Do you think your sin will disappear if you lie?
Tell me, what do you think is the ultimate fear?
Even if you can forget, you can't erase the past.
When you're in the darkness, you only sink deeper into it. Keep the light shining.
I realized that human lives have equal value — by saving you, nobody has the right to take another's life.
He doesn't harbour the cheap racism and prejudices that you all do... Johan looks down on all humans.
You can't just erase people's feelings.
Everyone in this world carries around their own sins, and they never go away, but that doesn't change the fact that we do what we must.
In your hearts, you know what's right. The answer is sitting there, waiting for you. Are you brave enough to look inside yourselves?
Don't just follow orders, you're men, not machines.
My emotions got lost somewhere inside me. They're like a letter I sent to myself... that took decades to arrive.
If you don't want to be betrayed anymore, then start by doubting the person you want to doubt the least.
There's not a human around who can be somewhere without leaving a trace. If they can do that, then they're not human.
People are certainly designed so conveniently.
People are such strange beings. The sad memories seem to just fade away, until all a person is left with are the happier ones.
But when you die, it's all the same.
If you don't have any happy memories, then make them.

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: If I happen to die because of this, get rid of my PC.

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: How about you squeeze into my stomach, Veldora?

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: A king who reigns but doesn't rule. Sounds good to me.

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: I'm not a bad slime, you know!

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: If you are starved, then I am a devourer. I will devour your sins and the sins of your kind.

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: Your actions could lead to immediate hostilities with us, depending on how this goes.

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: If I had to watch my friends die of old age, I would probably choose solitude as well.

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: Instead of fear, I hope you can accept us with open arms. I say these words from the very bottom of my heart.

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: You humans have ransacked my territory, and you must pay this crime with your lives.

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: Look carefully at who your opponent is, then speak. If you think I'm a nice person, you'll be sorely mistaken.

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: Your students are my students, master. I'll protect them with my life.

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: During this time I was in heaven. But fun times never last long. That's just how life is.

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: Humans live with groups. If you mess with them, they could retaliate in a big way. And if they came after us in earnest, I doubt we could handle them. Besides, getting along benefits us in lots of ways, anyway.

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: As you have just learned through experience, I am strong! And as such, I promise to save all of you.

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: Rest easy. I'll devour all your sins along with you.

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: No one died, so we'll say it's all good.

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: In this world, it's eat or be eaten.

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: Uh-huh. I see, I see. How can this be?! I was such a hot, manly man, but now I've taken on this refined, streamlined form! Yeah, right, idiot! Like hell I can accept that! But… I am a slime, aren't I?

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: I want to make this world one where everyone can live in peace, too.

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: Well, you've all gotten stronger by evolving, right? It means you shouldn't let that get to your head and push weaker races around. Don't make the mistake of thinking you're better than them. You don't want them getting stronger themselves and retaliating someday, do you?

quotes.animeName: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
quotes.text: Your lax attitude is what will get you killed.
Live… and be free. From the bottom of my heart, I love you.
Dead people receive more flowers than living ones because regret is stronger than gratitude.
You were the first person to ever be nice to me. You meant the world to me.
One needs a lot of courage to say the words 'I love you.'
I want to know what 'I love you' means…
No letter that could be sent deserves to go undelivered.
Everything is temporary. Emotion, thoughts, people, and scenery.
Sometimes we create our own heartbreaks through expectations.
Goodbye is so bitter while 'I love you' carries a far off scent.
You don't realize your body is on fire and burning up because of the things you've done. You'll understand one day. And then you'll realize for the first time that you have many burns.
I really, really wanted you to not have died. I wanted you to live… to live and grow up.
I do not believe there is God, but if there is, surely it must be you.
Thank you for making my dream come true. Thank you. As though I feel I've witnessed a miracle.
A letter can sometimes be short and sweet, and still, express important feelings.
Words can have different interpretations. What one says isn't the whole truth.
I want to know how he really feels.
Autonomous Ultra Instinct.
Oh, yes, I believe I do. This is so amazing — I never knew a Saiyan could achieve this form.
Out of all people, why does it have to be him!
I cannot afford to let Kakarot be killed, as it is because of him that I pursue the path to power — and because he is my rival.
Bowing down to your enemy is the same as giving up. The Saiyan pride is the strength of the Saiyans.
I want you to surpass me in strength, but I won't be the one training you — you must train relentlessly.
The Super Saiyan transformation is achieved through anger.
Your attempts are futile. No matter how strong you are, if you keep getting hit in your vital areas, you will die. You should surrender.
How incredibly young and naïve you must be, to reveal your plan so easily.
Your excessive strength makes you careless.
Life is strange, don't you think? A few years ago I was programmed to hunt and kill you, but now I'm fighting alongside you on your team.
Nah, don't beat yourself up. Most of my friends started out as my enemies too — Piccolo, Tenshinhan and Vegeta.
If we're doomed, then so be it. That'll mean everyone will be obliterated together, not just the helpless. It's a fair price — one I can accept.
It isn't in your place to interfere — your role in the tournament is over.
The light attacks you use are your main weakness. I will beat you with a head-on attack.
I am Beerus' martial arts master.
Do you remember when we used to train together under Master Roshi? But now, you've grown strong enough to be a match for even the God of Destruction, Beerus.
Kakarot, let's switch places — I'd like to kill Freeza myself.
I vow to train and get stronger, to protect my family.
If Monaka is disturbed during his meditation, he will incinerate you — regardless of position.
This isn't a tale about a boy who aims to become Hokage. That was my dad's story. This is none other than my story!
To me, Hokage is just a path. Just because my grandpa and dad are Hokage doesn't mean that I have to walk the same path.
Why don't you do one good thing for the world instead of wasting your life?
Please make me your disciple. There's someone I really want to defeat no matter what.
I'll walk my own path.
The age of shinobi… shall end.
I plan on becoming the Hokage by choosing a different path than my dad.
You adults can't tell me what to do. I'll decide what I want to do for myself.
Death by sword. Death by broken bones. Death by crushing. There's not much difference, right? You die at the end.
The most enjoyable thing now might be taking over the world.

I deserve the scolding. Despite all the information we had gathered, I never thought something like this would be a possibility. The mistake was mine and mine alone, understand? Shalltear, you are not guilty of anything.
I have one goal. There is only one thing I want to achieve. Happiness.
It seems even insects smell tasty when they're roasted.
Are you going to kill him? If you are, I was thinking I'd want to skin him. I think his skin would make a nice hide.
Do you realize it now? I am cruel, cold, and terrible. As well as quite a beautiful little monster.
A story of a certain summer. A story of a certain night.
Are you willing to die for me then?
I'm in love. I can't control it. It can't be fixed. But I can't resist.
At first, it almost felt like a curse, but it was basically my new start.
If suddenly the person you love completely disappeared from the world… what would you say?
Whatever. If I'm gonna die, might as well go while I'm still young.
It was like just the act of being alive pained him.
Your life is your own, and it's up to you to live it exactly the way you want.
Embrace those parts of yourself and try to live positively. Become a good person, simple as that.
I've always known, from the beginning, what my master really is.
Now I know that I might be able to change others too.
Never mind. Sometimes you need to be hurt to truly understand.
Everyone grows because of their encounters with other people. People need other people. Someday you'll need others too.
Just as happiness shines in the shadows of sorrow, only in the darkest depths of fear does courage truly shine.
Did you just one word me? 'Oh cool!' would be more humane.
Call me crazy, but I know what I saw. Snowflakes began to fall right here in Okinawa.
Anytime, anywhere, under any circumstance. It's the best. No limits, only possibility.
It doesn't matter if we win or lose. We're still your friends who love to skate.
I don't want to cheer from the sidelines. I want to be skating beside you.
There's only one reason anyone should get involved with skating. 'Cuz it's fun.
I'm not just the redhead. My name is Reki… remember it!
You know what sucks about the way you say 'I'm fine'? The fact that you never really are.
No duct tape again, you almost died, remember?
The more you bail, the better you get.
I've already taken the first step, so I'm determined to see it through.
There's no point in using logic with idiots.
You need to take care of yourself.
Don't be scared, darlings. Daddy knows you can handle it.
A person who can't care about himself can't protect anyone, I think.
I would solve a friend's problem... then also find a way to keep them from ending up with a new one.
What good are dreams if all you do is work? There's more to life than hitting the books, I hope you know.
I think... once you've decided to change, then you've already begun your transformation.
It's easy to feel sorry for him, but the hardships that he endured as a child molded him into the person he is today.
I like people who put in effort even if they're not good at it.
Nothing can be communicated without words, but if you really care about someone, even the smallest details are important to notice.
I would think that embracing the things you truly like and being able to enjoy them is worth more than anything.
It's fine if he holds bad judgments without getting to know me. The real point is letting just the ones who want to understand me know my true self.
Why should I care about appearances and labels, anyway? It's what's on the inside that counts.
I grant a wish for whoever summons me and take one thing as a payment.
I'll have you pay me back with your body.
In a world without life and death, people who don't know when to give up are unstoppable.
If you borrow my power, you need to pay a fair price.
When you die, that's it. There is nothing more. Nothing new begins.
Power beyond your ability brings nothing but destruction, boy.
No matter how much you regret or wish, if you couldn't do something in life, you can't do it after death either.
Humans and apparitions should just be however they want. If that would break the world, then it's better off broken.
If you want power beyond human comprehension, the price will be that much steeper.
I like the way people look when they stop holding it in.
I'm an apparition. The seventh of the seven wonders of the school, 'Hanako-san of the Bathroom.'
I want the person I like to return my feelings right away!!
I'll do it. I want to change back! Please, Hanako-san, make me a human again!!
You are not doing this because you love him; you're doing it for yourself.
You know, maybe you shouldn't have forced yourself. Just be yourself.
Who the hell are you? Get your hands off, my friend!!
I don't mind dying if it is to keep everyone safe.
Just because you are dead doesn't mean we can't be friends.
It's gonna take some time… I'm gonna get stronger just like you, Teru-nii. And then I'm gonna decide what to do. If I need to, I'll exorcise him! So keep your hands off him!!
You should make your decision. Just make sure you don't regret it.
I don't have much power left… but I'll help you as much as I can. If you ever need someone to talk to, I'm here. I'm not human… but I'm still technically your teacher.
He is a ghost… But he is my friend. But he disappeared once. I couldn't save him.
A rice ball doesn't belong in a fruits basket.
My happiness comes from the kindness of those around me.

It's not always easy to see the good in people. In some people, you might even doubt that it's there at all. But if you can somehow, find a way to believe...sometimes that's all it takes to help someone, to give them the strength to find the good in themselves.
My mom told me, it's better to trust people than to doubt them.
Being away from everyone else may be lonely, but being away from you will be even lonelier.
It's okay to feel weak sometimes. It's okay to be afraid. The important thing is that we face our fears. That's...that's what makes us strong.

They say that we should love ourselves first before other people learn to love us, but it's not as easy as it seems. Sometimes, we need someone to love us and accept us first, then we would learn to see ourselves through that person's eyes and learn to love ourselves.
I won't ask what you wish for. I only hope it comes true by your own two hands.

I think... when you hear someone say they like you, for the first time... then you can begin to like yourself. I think when someone accepts you, for the first time... you feel like you can... forgive yourself a little. You can begin to face your fears... with courage.
I'm gonna take my place as a true member of this family!
Maybe I'm not perfect. Maybe I have a long way to go. But someday... someday I'll be able to stand and walk on my own. Without hurting anyone... and without being a burden.
Be selfish, say what you want once in a while. It's okay to let yourself be sad.
I love you. When did I start to love you so much?
Ever since you left I've been getting pissed off about everything, and because I couldn't understand why, it just pissed me off even more!
I'll always love you.
It's you that I want. Do you not want me? Don't you want to be together?
A bond may seem like a beautiful thing from the outside...but if those involved see it as a burden, it's nothing but a shackle.
Your happiness is in a much more vast world. Look for it. Find it.
And if when everything ends, nothing is left in my hands...that's alright.
Sometimes I think the whole world is conspiring to destroy my house.
I yearn for you more than anyone else. I love you Akito... And that is the irrevocable unwavering truth.

But I think... I want to live with all my memories. Even if they're bad memories. Even if they're memories that only hurt me... that I'd rather forget. If I keep them and keep trying, without running away, then someday I'll be strong enough that those memories can't defeat me. I believe that because I want to think that there's no such thing as a memory that's ok to forget.
Pain, suffering. It's pointless to just think about those things.
Strangely enough, when you get older, the things you didn't understand when you were a child... start to make sense.
You can't have "hito", the character that means person, without two lines supporting each other.
No need to fear, Gure-San! Even if the entire world goes against you, I will forever be on your side!
Someday... no matter how cold it is now... the snow will melt. Without fail.
Often times in memory, we have the tendency to overly romanticize the people we care about.
If it's possible for one person to be hurt by another, then it's possible for that same person to be healed by another.
For there to be pain, there has to be kindness. For darkness to stand out, there has to be the sun.
Tohru, you must always be yourself and do things at your own pace. Someday... you'll catch up.
Is it okay for me to have my own life now, father, now that I'm not special anymore?
A sixth sense cannot make up for a total lack of common sense.
Maybe I was lonely. Maybe I've just... always... been lonely.
Just as no matter how hard you try to keep it away... despair will attack you again and again. In the same manner hope will return to you. Again and again.
Parents have no right to deprive their children of free will. But they do have a right to worry about them.
I want to be the only one... who can help the one I care about.
Starting today... I'll be with you! I'll always be by your side!
Caring for someone isn't based on logic. You can't really rationalize emotions. Once I think "I like him"... it's all over.
In a capitalist society, money and life are one and the same.
I despise the people who move the goalposts because they think they can't win.
I dislike situations where I know for sure if I'm going to win or lose. Because it's not really gambling.
The only one who can decide your worth is you. If you want to earn something, you need to reach out for it.
The amount of money one owns ultimately decides the victor. This doesn't stop within the walls of a casino, or it's cash flow. It's a rule that forms the basis for a capitalist society!
Friends assist each other in times of need, do they not?
You won't be able to fool anyone if you're not prepared to shed your own blood.
There are some things they can forgive and some things they can't.
I suppose I feel a little guilty about having no remorse.
The larger the ambition, the greater the risk.
The continuously advancing threat of danger with each move is almost charming.
Any player can take the scalp of another. That's what absolute neutrality means to me.
Then pay us what you owe!
All according to plan then, huh? But you know, every time things look like they're gonna go well, there's definitely always trouble moving in the background.
As they say, the less you know the better you sleep.
Put some wins under your belt and turn the tables. It's no reason to give up your ambitions!
I don't know who told you to do this, but tell me now what it is you really want!
I'll see for myself the way you'll look at me when I've claimed victory!
Sayaka, I told you before, you are simply fascinating.

They say humans are irrational creatures, but coming this far without a reason is rare. Gambling doesn't get them anything, they only lose something. But even so, we still gamble. We do that because we enjoy the risk.
You can only speculate based on the past. You won't really know what will happen until you play.
But don't difficult situations light a fire in you?
If winning were so simple, it would be too easy.
So as long as I don't give up, the possibility of winning will never fall to zero.
When you come to hate something you liked, it is incredibly painful.
If we give our best, we'll enjoy the victories from the bottom of our heart.
It's always better to have stronger opponents than weak ones.
You don't give up until the very end.
Be yourself because an original is worth more than a copy.
If we understood how other people felt, then nobody would ever start wars.
It's not the time to be scared. It's better if the opponent is strong.
The only one who can beat me is me.
If my opponents lose the will to play, what's fun about basketball anymore?
That's it. Show some spirit so you can entertain me, even a little.
For a winner, there is nothing to say to a loser.
I won't say you'll definitely be able to do it, if you don't give up.
Nothing beats cultivating talent.
Humans grow. Don't act like you understand when you don't even realize that.
When one thing ends, another begins.
Once you look up to someone, you can't overtake them.
If we have time to get upset, we should use that time to move on, just one step forward.
The only lucky item you'll need is already within, confidence.
We cannot be satisfied until we have eliminated all others. It has nothing to do with reason. It is instinct.

When I tell you to leave, leave. In this world, winning is everything. Winners are affirmed completely, and losers are denied completely. I've never lost at anything before, and I never will. Because I always win, and I'm always right. I show no mercy to those who oppose me, not even my own parents.
I do not allow anyone acting against me to look down upon me.
If their hearts get fragile, I'll become their support. If they are threatened, I'll become their shield. I'll sacrifice myself any day to protect everyone. That's why I came back!!
Awaken to your destiny, Arata Kasuga, for if you do not, I will have no choice but to kill you.
This is my magic: Outer Alchemic. It's essentially alchemy. Now, I use the term alchemy to describe it, but it has a myriad of different applications.
There are seven students here who are a little more like final bosses than drooling teenagers.
I'm a little too old to be tangling with you, darling. So I'd appreciate it if you spared me.
I'm interested because, you're the Demon Lord candidate. I'll never stop watching you, and I have a good reason. It's my fate, to become the bride of the Demon Lord.
I know. You must understand, this is my thema. This is the closest one can get to Ruina. No matter how immoral the pursuit of a thema is, it's a mage's duty to follow through with it.
A ninja can't expect much from anyone. And the nature of Yui's magic makes it really hard to get close to her. She and I are a lot alike in that way.
That's how a magic thema works. It's composed of a quality you don't have. At least, that's how it usually is. So since I can't expect much from anyone, I expect a lot from myself.
Illusion conceals purpose to create opportunities.
It doesn't matter what technique you use, it's not ever going to work against me. I'm light itself, and nothing in this world can travel faster.
Magic is doing the thing that seems furthest from what your rational mind wants you to do.
Loving someone means you want the best for them, and will do whatever it takes to make them happy. And I want that for my friends, the ones I love. That's all I want, more than anything.
I would do whatever it takes to save you. Anything in the world.
I've been asleep by myself in here this whole time. I might never have woken up if it hadn't been for you. You know, I'm kind of glad I didn't have anyone before.
You, you're not him. You're not Arata. You're not the person I know, so I have nothing to give to you, I will not be yours, not ever.

Akio's words took root in my heart that day. What she said made a lot of sense to me. I wanted to be more open about my power and I knew it would earn me respect. So that's how it went, more or less. I wanted to own my power and fight for justice, to take responsibility. And it just felt right.
You know, this pisses me off. We travel halfway around the world to stop a Breakdown Phenomenon, and find another one waiting for us when we get home.
Listen Mira, you have been blessed with such powerful magic. You might as well own it proudly. Use it with confidence.
I'm sure that you're aware that every mage ultimately wants to become a Demon Lord. So shouldn't it follow that any one of us will do whatever it takes to become a candidate?
Thank you, Arata. If anyone had cared about me as much you seem to now, who knows, with someone like you, I might not have ended up like this.
I'm almost a member of the Trinity Seven, and Lieselotte Sherlock is my big sister. I've spent a lot of time studying with her. I know all of the spells by heart.
You never fail to be inappropriate, do you master.

There's a risk involved with using the last crest. Pythagoras, the mage who created the technique, was trapped forever in this world, moving faster than light. In other words, he could never return to the ordinary world again.

Never underestimate the lengths a girl in love with a boy will go to. She'll want to know everything about him. She would want to tie him down. She wouldn't allow anyone else to get close to him. That's just how a girl acts when she's in love.
You became a mage just so you could try and bring me back. That means more to me than you could ever know.
If I don't have to do it, I won't. If I have to do it, I'll make it quick.
The more inexperienced you are, the more you want to show off.
A database can't draw conclusions.
People who are confident in themselves never talk about expectations. "Expectation" is a word rooted in giving up. It leaves you with no other choice. It makes it obvious that you're powerless.
Nothing beats an impromptu joke. It creates a breeding ground for lies.
Our days being spent aimlessly is not productive.
It's true that ten years from now, I might not care, but the feelings that I'm having now— They're something that I don't want to think will mean nothing in the future.
We don't know if trying our best will help, but we do know, that if we don't try our best, it won't help for sure!

I don't think it's good to never get angry. Just like about the other 7 sins, right? If someone didn't have any pride, wouldn't they also be lacking in self-confidence? If someone was free of greed, wouldn't they have trouble supporting their family? And if people didn't envy one another, wouldn't they stop inventing new things?
It's okay to get frustrated at times, it just shows that you're really invested into that thing.
I think it's hard to be perfect, so you shouldn't be.
I think it's extremely excruciating to see people with talent get chances that you haven't been able to get.
This is just the beginning of the amazing adventures of Ash and Pikachu...
Well this is getting to be a familiar scene. Sunny skies, balmy breezes, and our heroes drifting towards some tropical adventure. Announcers never get to have any fun!
As the journey continues!
You gotta keep smiling, no matter how tough things are getting.
I wanna make friends with all the Pokemon in the world.
Don't worry Brock, there's plenty of other girls to reject you.
Maybe you think I'm a little too brash, but the master is here, and his name is Ash.
If we're gonna try to catch a ghost Pokémon, we gotta learn to deal with fear.
Because I'm sensitive to others' feelings!
If you want that Cascade Badge, you're gonna have to beat me!
Don't you know that love is the most important thing in the whole world?
When you have lemons, you make lemonade; and when you have rice, you make rice balls.

We may not make a lot of money but at least we have our freedom.
Am I the only member of this team who thinks world domination is more important than lunch?
Drat, we wasted this episode cheering the good guys!
We have a proud tradition of failure to uphold!
Nothing makes me angrier than being told the truth!
You should look on the bright side. At least you guys were the top of the bottom.
This is our 500th heist!

quotes.text: Besides, he is far from my type of man. First, he seems to be of absolutely decent character, he never shows anger towards anyone, he works hard, and was strong enough to achieve knighthood at the earliest age on record.
If I'm going to die anyway, at least I'll die trying.
Come back safely. I'll be waiting for you forever.
We are from different countries, and our skin and eyes are different colors. But so what?
I think I wanted to protect you from your future because your fate was sweeping you away like a flood.
I know we'll meet again, no matter how far apart we are. You're the greatest friend I'll ever have.
I'm really glad I came to America. I met lots of people, and more than anything; I met you.
My words might not mean anything now, but just remember one thing—even if the world turns on you, I'll always be on your side.
You asked me many times if you scare me, but I never felt scared of you, not even once from the first time I met you.
War is always good business for those in power.
They paid the price for their decisions, that's all.
I don't care who it is. I am not letting anybody hurt you, Eiji.
That guy always regarded me as a human being with a real heart, not some sort of tool.
Even if you bust him, he'll bail himself out in half an hour. Even a stupid street punk like me knows that!
I wish I could hate you. I need someone to hate.
I wasn't expecting the law to protect me. I've ignored it all my life.
No need to glare. I won't eat you up.
You want people to protect you, like with Ash, or make them want to tear you apart and crush you.
Depending on your answer, I may not forgive you.
If we don't fight back now, we'll forever be expendable tools.
If you go alone, you'll just be killed. You'll die for nothing!
Everyone starts from zero. If you mess up, just try it. Figure out why, and try again.
You can have the bad days so you can love the good days even more.
Under such circumstances, you shouldn't say 'where are you going' but rather 'don't go'.
I'm in love with you Hori-san, have been for a while now.
Hori-san, I don't know very much about you, but I'd like to learn more.
Nobody's good at anything when they first start.
What I like about Hori-san is that she doesn't judge people by appearances.
It might be really hard but, I don't think there's a person you can't eventually be friends with.
I kinda don't want anyone else to see you like this, Miyamura.
Everyone has a side of themselves that they don't want other people to see.
Sometimes I'm not sure if you're incredibly bold or incredibly stupid.
Miyamura is mine! You can't have him!
Only morons catch a cold in the summer.
You're kind of weird, but that's okay. You're just kind of awkward.
The snow melts because it decides to melt on its own.
You look really cute, Sakura.
I had a crush on you first, Hori-senpai!
She makes me want to protect her, I'm not even that strong.
If the world was going to end tomorrow, I'd tell you I like you.
It only hurts more because, nobody is in the wrong.
I got rejected before I even had a chance to ask him out.
I'm just an old-fashioned cowboy.
I hate kids and pets. They're all a royal pain in the butt!
Well, here's another great moment in the legend of Spike, famous bounty hunter and dog walker.

The music box is broken, or is it? It starts to play and a haunting tune fills the air. I awake suddenly from my dream, there is no music box and yet there it is, a tiny one, nestled in my hand and I awake from the dream again as if I were peeling an onion. It's a dream no matter how far I go; I can never reach reality, trapped in an endless nightmare.
I'm just watching a bad dream I never wake up from.

You're tense, I'm calm. You apply excessive force, I control that force through fluid motion. That means relaxing the whole body so that it could react instantly without resistance. You know, without thought. Do you see now? It means becoming like clear water.
Something beautiful, huh? I'm afraid that… afraid that I lost that a long time ago.
You know the first rule of combat? Shoot them before they shoot you.
You don't know anything, do you? Romanies are gypsies! And you know what we call someone like you? A Gorgio—that means a bumpkin that doesn't know which way is up.
When you're told not to open something, well, who can resist?
You know what they say cowboy, easy come easy go.
"Survival of the fittest" is the law of nature. We deceive or we are deceived. Thus, we flourish or perish. Nothing good ever happened to me when I trusted others. That is the lesson.

Humans were meant to work and sweat to earn a living. Those that try to get rich quick, or live at the expense of others, all get divine retribution somewhere along the line. That's the lesson. Unfortunately we quickly forget the lessons we've learned, and then we have to learn them all over again.
I'm the Black Dog, and once I bite, I don't let go. I have no regrets about her, but I'll settle this score on my own terms.
Don't be dense. I started wailing the blues when the doctor whacked my bottom on the day I was born.
When angels are forced out of heaven, they become devils. You agree, don't you, Spike?
A ravenous beast. The same blood runs through both of us. The blood of a beast who wanders, hunting for the blood of others.

Drink my blood, Police Girl. Drink, and you shall never again be treated like a slave. Drink, and you shall truly become one of us. You will drink blood of your own choosing - wandering the night, powerful and singular. Become eternal and complete! Drink my blood, Police Girl. No... Seras Victoria!

Come on, get up! Attack me! You've only suffered the loss of your legs! Summon up your familiars! Transform your body! Heal your severed legs and stand! The evening is still so young. Come on, hurry, hurry, hurry! Pull yourself together - the fun has just begun! Come on! HURRY!

We ruin the countries we govern and the people in our care. We slaughter our enemies and sacrifice all our allies. We'll keep killing till there's nothing left but to destroy ourselves. It will never be enough.
Giving up is what kills people. Those who refuse to give up are entitled their time to trample upon the weak.

Anderson, stop it! Do you know what that thing will do to you?! You'll become one of God's monsters! Retain your humanity. Don't succumb to power! Either side, it amounts to the same deal: whether in the name of the divine or the demonic, you're still a monster in the end!
Only a human can destroy a monster. Only a human could dare hope to.
You are me... I was just the same! Don't you understand, this is how I became what I am?
Every time I die, this is the vision that greets my eyes. And every time I think, 'How lovely that sunlight which I forsook so many centuries ago...'
They're not real people. They're like...zombie pumpkins.
It felt like if I drank the blood, it would mean the end of something important inside of me.
I'm not afraid of anything anymore.
He looked like a child, who just woken up from a pleasant dream. These men... They've been trapped in the same dream since World War II. But tonight, Mr. Bernadotte, I'll wake them up. All of them.
They have dared to enter this house, built on blood and honour. I will see them roast in the deepest pits of Hell!

Don't you dare question my resolve! I have already given you your marching orders, soldier! You will search and destroy! SEARCH AND DESTROY! Any resistance you encounter is to be CRUSHED! Hellsing does not run from our enemies! Kill them all!
Don't underestimate humanity, you freaks! Come on! Let's have it!
Just what I expected from a king of vampires. Or a count.
I must say, this is an excellent museum. Perhaps next time, I'll be allowed to bring the children from the orphanage.
It was never about the money, it was always about the fun.

I answer to no man's will, but my own. I am myself in mind, body, and soul. I am Walter C. Dornez, the angel of death, and as the dawn light cuts through the darkness, so shall I reap all of your souls in bloody turn.
We are the evening's entertainment. And I... just wanted to do something with my time on the stage worthy of applause.
The show is over, Mina. The curtain's falling, we've taken our bows, it's high time we made our exit.
I am everywhere and nowhere.

You're so slow. In the time it took you to walk down one little hallway, I went all the way to London, got my head blown off, and made it back. Perhaps you should start thinking about going on a diet, mein Major.
My friends, it has often been said that I like war. Friends, I like war. No, friends, I love war!
By the time they realize their destinies never left my palm, my fist will have already closed in around them.
Here it comes - I can feel it! A mighty river...a river of death! The dead shall dance...and all of Hell shall sing!
I'm the huntress, Rip van Winkle. Tinker, tailor, soldier, sailor - my bullet punishes all without distinction.
I can offer you my pity, but my forgiveness? NEVER! Now prepare to be purged from the earth! Mowed down like grass... CRUSHED LIKE BUGS!!!
Amen! I accept this with all my being! Your target is London- destroy it! Let this new era of Catholic might, this Reconquista- now begin!
I know I won't be here, but I'll be with you in spirit.
Yuri's life and love have opened up a brand new world for me, one I never knew existed.
If you don't have the strength to motivate someone who looks up to you, how can you find the strength to motivate yourself?
You have to do the opposite of what people expect. How else will you surprise them?
When I get away from skating, two L words come to mind, Life and Love. I've been neglecting both for over twenty years.
If you mess up this free skate and miss the podium, I'll take responsibility by resigning as your coach.
I don't really have a name for that emotion. But I have decided to call it love. It's changed me. I'm stronger now.
Just have more faith that I'm going to win than I do! You don't have to say anything. Just stay close to me!
You are the femme fatale of the pork cutlet bowl.
Win or lose, we call everything on the ice love.
There's a place you just can't reach unless you have a dream too large to bear alone.
He never fails to surprise me. Ever since I first saw his skating, it's been a never-ending chain of surprises.
I want to be hated as the man who took Victor from the world.
But I got bored of feeling depressed, so I got to thinking... I wanted to get my love for skating back.
Without inspiration, you're as good as dead.
If selling my soul is what it takes to win, I'll give you this body, no holds barred.
If you retire now, I'll make you regret it for the rest of your life.
No matter what I did, it was no use. It's like I can't speak.
What if I can't become friends with them? What if they ignore me? Or think I'm weird?
I can't even say hi to people, even though it seems so simple for others.
My dream is to make a hundred friends.
Thanks a lot, I really had fun.
Was I being weird? Why the cat ears?
I know that understanding the atmosphere and not standing out is the key to happiness.
I'll be your first friend and help you make the rest.
I'm happy that I'm sitting next to the prettiest girl in class, but at the same time I feel like I have a bounty on my head.
Sorry Komi, I'm completely useless.

Saying thanks for appearing in a hallucination is too creepy.
Food tastes better if you eat it with someone else.

Thanks to you, I changed a little.

Just because a person has problems communicating doesn't mean that person doesn't want to communicate with others.
I mustn't run away.
Unfamiliar ceiling.

Acts of men are better than acts of God.
Never underestimate the ability of the human-animal to adapt to its environment.

Man, air conditioning is the greatest thing. Man's triumph over nature.
Man fears the darkness, and so he scrapes away at the edges of it with fire.
One who truly hates himself cannot love.
You misunderstood from the very beginning. You just believed what you wanted to believe.
The things I possess are a life and soul. I am a vessel for a soul.
It is simply the duty of the elite to protect the ignorant masses.

Man cannot erase this sadness, because all men are fundamentally alone.
Mankind's greatest fear is mankind itself.
Because there is no one else who can.

There are as many truths as there are people.
